sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. Applicability is correctly gated: non-linear readiness is required only when explicit nonlinearCalculationMethod evidence and a typed calculation case are present, while the inapplicable branch forbids both. Authoritative owners, required calculation-case operands, controlled nonlinear method value, acceptance evidence, assessment result, response terms, and declared units are correctly encoded without inventing thresholds or executing the complex formula.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the owner and applicability semantics. The requirement is conditional on non-linear evaluation, so do not impose sh:minCount 1 for a nonlinear calculation case on every targeted ship; gate the readiness constraints on explicit nonlinear calculation-method evidence without allowing a missing selector to pass. Keep fractureMargin, majorBucklingMargin, and yieldingMargin on their authoritative ship owner, but place permanentLateralDeformation, permanentOutOfPlaneDeformation, and relevantStructuralDimension on the calculationCase node, as their canonical requiredOwner is calculationCase. Also explicitly encode the required analysis-readiness evidence that the nonlinear analysis captures buckling and plastic deformation, using the supplied canonical bucklingResponse and plasticDeformation terms on their authoritative ship owner, rather than relying only on acceptance evidence and the minor-deformation boolean.

The candidate preserves the required owners and terms, but applicability is still wrong. The unconditional sh:minCount 1 constraints on nonlinearCalculationMethod, bucklingResponse, plasticDeformation, fractureMargin, majorBucklingMargin, and yieldingMargin make every targeted ship fail when it is not evaluated by a nonlinear method. Gate the complete readiness requirement on explicit nonlinear-method applicability, while ensuring that an applicable nonlinear case cannot pass with a missing selector, case, or required evidence. Keep ship-owned margins and buckling/plastic response terms on the ship, and keep deformation operands, calculationMethod, acceptance evidence, and minorPermanentDeformationAssessmentSatisfied on each applicable calculationCase. Do not use the current unconditional ship constraints as the applicability test.

The conditional logic is close, but the applicable path can still pass with an untyped calculation-case node: the ship SPARQL only checks existence of any nltl:hasCalculationCase value, while NonlinearCalculationCaseShape is targeted only by rdf:type nltl:calculationCase. Add a conditional relationship/type check requiring each applicable ship-linked case to be an nltl:calculationCase (for example, a ship property shape with sh:path nltl:hasCalculationCase and sh:class nltl:calculationCase, without unconditional minCount, plus the existing applicability gate). Ensure the applicable case is therefore validated for its calculationMethod, acceptance evidence, boolean result, and all three millimetre quantity operands; preserve the prior owner and conditional-applicability instructions.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. Applicability is correctly gated: non-linear readiness is required only when explicit nonlinearCalculationMethod evidence and a typed calculation case are present, while the inapplicable branch forbids both. Authoritative owners, required calculation-case operands, controlled nonlinear method value, acceptance evidence, assessment result, response terms, and declared units are correctly encoded without inventing thresholds or executing the complex formula.
